name: Comparing Literals
hint: Reporter blocks are used to evaluate the truth value of certain expressions. If you compare two literals, the result will always be the same, TRUE or FALSE.[newLine]The blocks in the control body will be executed always or never. Therefore comparison is not necessary.
instruction: Maybe you wanted to create a new Variable [sbi](score)[/sbi] to store information.[newLine]New variables can be created in the Variables category.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when I start as a clone
if < [score] > (20) :: #ff0000 > then //⇦  🐛
switch costume to (profi v)
end

examples.label: Possible Solution
examples.scratchblocks:
(score)

when I start as a clone
if < (score) > (20) :: #007000 > then //⇦  👍
switch costume to (profi v)
end
